current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction
canonical_title: Fire protection of flight control system components, engine mounts and other flight

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.title_at_revision: Fire protection of flight control system components, engine mounts and other flight structure
versions.text: See AMC.865 Flight control system components, engine mounts, and other flight structure located in designated fire zones, or in adjacent areas that would be subjected to the effects of fire in the designated fire zones, must be constructed of fireproof material or be shielded so that they are capable of withstanding the effects of a fire. Engine vibration isolators must incorporate suitable features to ensure that the engine is retained if the non-fireproof portions of the isolators deteriorate from the effects of a fire.
